title: My Heroes
description: Three playable heroes (Flash, Kingpin, Thanos) with 8 abilities each. Controls: V (switch), R (activate), B (toggle hotbar).
body:
Got it, here's the plain text version:

---

# My Heroes Mod

Choose from 5 unique superheroes and unleash devastating abilities! Complete quests, defeat powerful bosses, earn coins and buy epic items!

---

## Heroes (5)

- Speedster - Lightning speed & time control
- Crime Boss - Brute strength & intimidation
- Titan - Infinity Stones power
- Web Hero - Spider-like agility
- Dr. Mystic - Mystic arts & dimensions

Each hero has 8 unique abilities with custom particles and sounds!

---

## Bosses (2)

- Speedster Boss - Lightning, Flash, Push & Phase attacks
- Crime Boss - Ground Slam, Bulldozer, Intimidation & Brute Force

Both bosses have custom AI, boss bars and special attack patterns.

---

## Quest System (28 Quests)

- 4 tiers from easy to extreme
- Kill mobs, collect items, defeat bosses
- Earn coins for completing quests
- Progress tracked per quest type

---

## Shop

Buy powerful items with coins:
- Diamonds, Golden Apples, Ender Pearls, XP Bottles
- Enchanted Golden Apple, Netherite Ingots, Totems of Undying
- Overload Potion (150 coins)

---

## Overload System

- /cooldowns command or Overload Potion disables all ability cooldowns for 10 seconds
- After 10 seconds you get extreme debuffs for 3 minutes
- Debuffs include: Slowness IV, Weakness V, Hunger VI, Poison III, Nausea, Blindness, Darkness, Wither II

---

## Controls

- V - Switch battle slot
- R - Use ability / Buy locked slot
- Sneak + R - Alternative ability
- B - Toggle battle hotbar

---

## Commands

- /heroselect speedster/crimeboss/titan/webhero/mystic - Choose your hero
- /guidebook - Get hero selection book
- /stats - View your level, XP, skill points and mob kills
- /cooldowns - Toggle 10s cooldown-free mode
- /buy diamond/golden_apple/ender_pearl/xp_bottle/enchanted_golden_apple/netherite/totem/overload - Buy items

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or higher
- Fabric API
- Java 21

---

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21
2. Download Fabric API and put it in your mods folder
3. Download this mod and put it in your mods folder
4. Launch the game and enjoy!
